Truth ENB

ENB shader suite

Truth ENB is a from-scratch ENBSeries 0.504 shader suite for Skyrim SE/AE, with a computed physical atmosphere and sky, raymarched clouds, an aurora curtain, exposure and tone mapping, five quality tiers, and an optional native camera bridge.

Who it is for

Audiences

  • Skyrim ENB users
  • ENB preset and shader authors
  • Skyrim mod developers

Deployment contexts

  • Skyrim SE/AE with ENBSeries 0.504
  • partial optical and post-processing use with Community Shaders and Effects 11
  • local Windows shader and runtime development

Inputs and outputs

Inputs

  • Skyrim scene, depth, weather, time, interior, bloom, lens, and adaptation data
  • one supported shader host and one selected quality-tier overlay
  • optional native camera data and SkyrimBridge celestial data

Outputs

  • a nine-stage Skyrim ENB shader suite
  • procedural sky, cloud, aurora, optical, exposure, color, and tone-mapped frame output
  • deterministic release-candidate archives, WARP reference captures, and verification reports

Architecture, dependencies, and relationship notes

Dependencies

  • enb-runtime-core

Relation-backed claims

  • Truth ENB build dependency ENB Runtime Core
    Truth ENB pins ENB Runtime Core for its native runtime build.
  • Truth ENB optional runtime integration SkyrimBridge
    SkyrimBridge is optional for the base optical suite and supplies celestial data used by the current procedural sky path.

Current evidence

Truth ENB 1.0.0 source

Verified 2026-08-28

How we know

CMake identifies project version 1.0.0. Current main is c2eaa9f, 32 commits after release-candidate tag v1.0.0-rc.1. Public upload remains blocked until the required live Skyrim SE/AE and ENB 0.504 acceptance runs are recorded.

Truth ENB runtime-core build linkage

Verified 2026-08-28

How we know

The pinned CMake source compiles and links ENB Runtime Core into the Truth runtime target.

Truth ENB optional SkyrimBridge bindings

Verified 2026-08-28

How we know

The pinned shader source defines SkyrimBridge interoperability as an optional surface and preserves a safe path when its values are absent.

Limitations and authorization boundaries

  • Public upload remains blocked until the required live Skyrim SE/AE and ENB 0.504 acceptance matrix is recorded.
  • The Community Shaders and Effects 11 path currently covers only partial optical and post-processing compatibility; world-space prepass composition remains disabled there.
  • Generated promotional art is not gameplay evidence; visual-quality claims require labeled in-game captures.

Authorization boundary. Truth does not bundle ENBSeries, Community Shaders, Effects 11, Address Library, SkyrimBridge, or Bethesda shader source. Install one supported shader host and the required game and runtime dependencies separately.
